summary: Review-required audit trail for the live font-cache cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and repo cleanup docs describe the same cache files and service handling, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Font Cache
setting.casual_explanation: This clears the Windows font-cache files so they can be rebuilt later.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear the font cache when they are troubleshooting corrupted font rendering or stale font-cache state.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing the cache can help when font-cache state is broken, but it is still a maintenance action and not a normal on/off preference.
setting.professional_notes: The current app stops the FontCache service, deletes the LocalService font-cache directory and FNTCACHE.DAT, and then starts the service again. Repo cleanup docs describe the same cache files and troubleshooting context.

allowed_values.label: No cleanup action
allowed_values.meaning: Font-cache files remain until Windows or an operator removes them.

allowed_values.label: Clear font cache
allowed_values.meaning: Stops the FontCache service, removes the tracked cache files, and restarts the service.

targets.notes: This is a one-shot cleanup action rather than a persistent font configuration setting.

app_current_implementation.notes: The live app still ships this as a first-party cleanup card instead of through the research-provider surface.

decision.why: The live cleanup behavior and repo-backed file targets are clear, but this one-shot cleanup card still lives only in the first-party provider.
blocking_issues: The card has not yet been promoted from the first-party cleanup provider into the research-provider surface.
This is a maintenance action with no rollback support.
decision.promotion_disposition_reason: Closed as rejected for research-provider promotion because the live action is one-shot, destructive, high-risk, reboot-sensitive, or lacks a rollback story suitable for a validated tweak card.
decision.promotion_reopen_criteria: Reopen only if the app gains a verified rollback/snapshot contract and dedicated validation proof for the exact action.
